note: T-214 validation: every measure where the measurer and T-204's hand trace of the same T-202 render differ by more than the T-204 tolerance, with the reason. test_measurer.py fails on any disagreement not listed here. Categories: H = hand crown/chin estimate (agrees once the hand crown and chin are used); TRACE = hand trace differs from the render (checked on the pixels); SHADE = Cycles shading moves an edge the masks cannot see; RIM = hand stopped at the glasses rim; HIDDEN = feature hidden under hair or lens, hand estimate (E).
